$comment: 22 张大阿卡纳实际画面的可见符号标注（奶蛙传统故事牌组 v1）。只记录画面中真实可见的元素；review_status 为 draft，待人工核对。

visual_description.zh: 满月下的悬崖石径上，奶蛙肩扛挂着布包袱的木棍站着，一只深色小狗在崖边仰头看它；远处山顶是亮着灯的哥特城堡和瀑布。
visual_description.en: On a cliff-top stone path under a full moon, Naiwa stands with a bindle on its shoulder while a small dark dog at the cliff edge looks up at it; a lit gothic castle and waterfalls rise in the distance.

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙脚下的石径通向断崖边缘
visual_symbols.en: the stone path under Naiwa runs out to a sheer cliff edge

visual_symbols.zh: 肩上扛着木棍，棍头挂着扎口的布包袱
visual_symbols.en: a stick over its shoulder with a tied cloth bundle

visual_symbols.zh: 一只深灰褐色小狗站在崖边，抬头望着奶蛙
visual_symbols.en: a small dark grey-brown dog at the cliff edge looking up at Naiwa

visual_symbols.zh: 路旁和画面下方开着几朵黑玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: several black roses grow by the path and along the bottom

visual_symbols.zh: 一轮巨大的满月
visual_symbols.en: a large full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 远处山顶的哥特城堡，窗里亮着灯，旁有拱桥
visual_symbols.en: a gothic castle with lit windows and arched bridges on a distant peak

visual_symbols.zh: 云雾中的悬崖上挂着几道瀑布
visual_symbols.en: waterfalls pour down misty cliffs

visual_symbols.zh: 右侧一棵枝叶带金色的扭曲老树
visual_symbols.en: a gnarled tree with gold-tinged leaves on the right

lighting.zh: 月夜冷光，云层发亮，局部金色高光
lighting.en: cold moonlight with glowing clouds and gold highlights

artworks.notes: scene 写「黑狗凑到脚边」，实际狗为深灰褐色，站在崖边离奶蛙有一段距离、仰头看它；scene 写「一朵黑玫瑰」，实际可见多朵；scene 写「废弃的城堡」，画面中城堡窗户亮灯，不太像废弃。

visual_description.zh: 哥特礼拜堂的红色玫瑰窗前，奶蛙站在石祭坛后，一手高举发光的权杖，头顶浮着发光的无限符号；祭坛上摆着权杖、圣杯、短剑和五芒星金币。
visual_description.en: Before a red rose window in a gothic chapel, Naiwa stands behind a stone altar raising a glowing wand, a glowing infinity sign above its head; a wand, chalice, dagger and pentacle coin lie on the altar.

visual_symbols.zh: 右手高举一根顶端闪着星光的权杖
visual_symbols.en: one hand raises a wand with a star-like glint at its tip

visual_symbols.zh: 头顶浮着发红橙光的无限符号
visual_symbols.en: a glowing red-orange infinity sign floats above its head

visual_symbols.zh: 祭坛上依次摆着金色短杖、宝石圣杯、短剑和刻五芒星的金币
visual_symbols.en: a golden rod, jewelled chalice, dagger and pentacle coin lie on the altar

visual_symbols.zh: 雕着哥特尖拱的石祭坛，搭着两条深红金纹布
visual_symbols.en: a stone altar carved with gothic arches, draped with two crimson cloths

visual_symbols.zh: 另一只手张开向外下方伸出
visual_symbols.en: the other hand is open, reaching outward and downward

visual_symbols.zh: 祭坛前开着白百合
visual_symbols.en: white lilies bloom in front of the altar

visual_symbols.zh: 黑红色玫瑰与百合混在一起
visual_symbols.en: dark red-black roses among the lilies

visual_symbols.zh: 身后是巨大的红色彩绘玫瑰窗
visual_symbols.en: a large red stained-glass rose window behind

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧各有点燃的金色烛台
visual_symbols.en: lit golden candelabras on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 右侧拱窗外可见满月与拱桥，左侧窗外是城堡
visual_symbols.en: a full moon and arched bridge through the right window, a castle through the left

lighting.zh: 烛光与红色彩窗的暖红光，权杖尖端发光
lighting.en: warm red light from candles and the stained-glass window, glowing wand tip

artworks.notes: scene 写「一手指地」，实际另一只手是张开手掌向外下方伸出，没有明确的手指指地动作；rws_ref 暂记 hand_pointing_down，需人工确认。玫瑰为黑红色，不是 RWS 的鲜红玫瑰。

visual_description.zh: 黑白两根石柱之间，奶蛙披紫色斗篷、头戴银色新月冠，坐在哥特石座上抱着古卷；身后挂着石榴纹帷幕，座前有发光的新月和一池映着月光的水。
visual_description.en: Between a black and a white pillar, Naiwa in a purple mantle and silver crescent crown sits on a gothic stone throne holding a scroll; a pomegranate tapestry hangs behind, a glowing crescent rests before the seat above a moonlit pool.

visual_symbols.zh: 左黑柱刻新月，右白柱刻太阳，都缠着金色藤纹
visual_symbols.en: a black pillar with a crescent on the left, a white pillar with a sun on the right, both with gold vines

visual_symbols.zh: 怀抱一卷画着星盘与月相的古卷
visual_symbols.en: holds a scroll marked with a star compass and moon phases

visual_symbols.zh: 身后紫红帷幕上绣着裂开的石榴
visual_symbols.en: a purple-red tapestry embroidered with split pomegranates behind

visual_symbols.zh: 座基前一弯发光的银色新月
visual_symbols.en: a glowing silver crescent at the base of the seat

visual_symbols.zh: 头戴镶紫宝石的银色新月头冠
visual_symbols.en: a silver crescent crown set with a violet gem

visual_symbols.zh: 座前一池水，漂着睡莲叶，倒映月光
visual_symbols.en: a pool with lily pads reflecting moonlight

visual_symbols.zh: 披着绣金纹的深紫色长斗篷
visual_symbols.en: a long deep-purple mantle with gold embroidery

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧开着白百合与紫黑玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: white lilies and purple-black roses on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 身后哥特尖窗外是满月和尖塔
visual_symbols.en: a full moon and spires through the gothic window behind

lighting.zh: 紫色调月光，冷而柔和
lighting.en: soft cool violet moonlight

artworks.notes: scene 写「低矮的石座」，实际是有扶手和高背的哥特石座；scene 未提新月头冠和水池。柱子上没有 B/J 字母；古卷上没有 TORA 字样，只是星盘与月相图。斗篷是紫色不是蓝色。

visual_description.zh: 常春藤与暗红玫瑰包围的花园里，奶蛙头戴缀星金冠，披米白绣金斗篷，靠坐在红丝绒金框宝座上，手持百合权杖；身旁是金星符号盾牌、石榴和金色麦穗。
visual_description.en: In a garden of ivy and dark red roses, Naiwa in a star-studded gold crown and cream embroidered mantle reclines on a red velvet gilded throne holding a lily sceptre; a Venus-symbol shield, pomegranates and golden wheat surround it.

visual_symbols.zh: 金冠上方环绕着一圈金色星星
visual_symbols.en: a gold crown ringed with golden stars

visual_symbols.zh: 宝座旁立着刻金星符号♀与月桂的盾牌
visual_symbols.en: a shield bearing the Venus symbol and laurel beside the throne

visual_symbols.zh: 右下方一丛金色麦穗
visual_symbols.en: a cluster of golden wheat at lower right

visual_symbols.zh: 完整和剖开的石榴散在花丛中
visual_symbols.en: whole and split pomegranates among the plants

visual_symbols.zh: 手持顶端开着白百合的金权杖
visual_symbols.en: a gold sceptre topped with white lilies

visual_symbols.zh: 红丝绒金框的宽大宝座
visual_symbols.en: a wide red velvet throne with a gilded frame

visual_symbols.zh: 四周满是暗红近黑的玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: dark red, near-black roses all around

visual_symbols.zh: 一束暖阳从右上方斜射下来
visual_symbols.en: a warm sunbeam slants in from the upper right

visual_symbols.zh: 爬满藤蔓的哥特拱廊废墟
visual_symbols.en: ivy-covered gothic arcade ruins

visual_symbols.zh: 披着米白色绣金花纹斗篷，胸前红宝石扣
visual_symbols.en: a cream mantle with gold floral embroidery and a ruby clasp

lighting.zh: 暖金色斜射阳光
lighting.en: warm golden slanting sunlight

artworks.notes: scene 写「十二星冠」，画面中星星大约 9～10 颗可辨，无法确认是 12 颗；scene 写「暖光刚好落在肚子上」，实际光束从右上照进画面，没有明确落在肚子上。scene 未提金星盾牌和百合权杖。

visual_description.zh: 血红色天空下，奶蛙戴红丝绒金冠，端坐在刻着四个公羊头的黑色石宝座上，一手十字顶权杖、一手金十字圆球；身后是锯齿状岩山和古拱桥。
visual_description.en: Under a blood-red sky, Naiwa in a gold crown sits upright on a black stone throne carved with four ram heads, cross-topped sceptre in one hand and gold orb in the other; jagged rock mountains and old aqueducts rise behind.

visual_symbols.zh: 宝座顶端和扶手上共四个铜色公羊头
visual_symbols.en: four bronze ram heads on the throne's top corners and armrests

visual_symbols.zh: 带尖顶装饰的黑色石宝座，立在台阶上
visual_symbols.en: a spired black stone throne atop steps

visual_symbols.zh: 一手握顶端为十字花饰、镶红宝石的金权杖
visual_symbols.en: holds a gold sceptre with a jewelled cross-fleury top

visual_symbols.zh: 另一手托着顶有十字的金色宝球
visual_symbols.en: holds a gold orb topped with a cross

visual_symbols.zh: 戴着镶红宝石、内衬红丝绒的金冠
visual_symbols.en: a gold crown with rubies and red velvet cap

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧是尖锐的灰色岩山，云雾缭绕
visual_symbols.en: sharp grey rock mountains wrapped in mist

visual_symbols.zh: 翻涌的血红色天空
visual_symbols.en: a churning blood-red sky

visual_symbols.zh: 红丝绒斗篷垂下，绣金色鹰纹
visual_symbols.en: a red velvet mantle with gold eagle embroidery drapes down

visual_symbols.zh: 山间有几段古拱桥
visual_symbols.en: old arched aqueducts among the mountains

lighting.zh: 血红天光与金色高光，对比强烈
lighting.en: blood-red skylight with strong gold highlights

artworks.notes: 权杖顶端是十字花饰而非埃及安卡（ankh），rws_ref 只表示对应位置；宝座正面有鹰徽和鸢尾花纹。与 scene 基本一致。

visual_description.zh: 哥特大教堂彩窗前，奶蛙戴三重冠、披深红绣金祭袍坐在石座上，举手祝福、手持三重十字杖；座前交叉两把金钥匙，两位戴兜帽的侍者跪在两侧。
visual_description.en: Before cathedral stained glass, Naiwa in a triple tiara and crimson gold-embroidered vestments sits on a stone throne, hand raised in blessing and holding a triple-cross staff; two golden keys cross before it and two hooded acolytes kneel at the sides.

visual_symbols.zh: 一只手竖起两指做祝福手势
visual_symbols.en: one hand raised with two fingers up in blessing

visual_symbols.zh: 座前台阶上交叉放着两把金钥匙
visual_symbols.en: two golden keys crossed on the step before the throne

visual_symbols.zh: 两位披米白兜帽袍、红色十字圣带的侍者低头跪着
visual_symbols.en: two acolytes in cream hooded robes with red cross stoles kneel, heads bowed

visual_symbols.zh: 戴着顶有十字的三重教冠
visual_symbols.en: a triple tiara topped with a cross

visual_symbols.zh: 另一只手握金色三重十字杖
visual_symbols.en: holds a gold triple-cross staff

visual_symbols.zh: 深红丝绒祭袍，圣带上绣金十字
visual_symbols.en: crimson velvet vestments with gold crosses on the stole

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧石柱壁龛里立着圣像
visual_symbols.en: pillars on both sides with saint statues in niches

visual_symbols.zh: 左侧金色香炉冒出缕缕烟雾
visual_symbols.en: smoke curls from a golden censer on the left

visual_symbols.zh: 身后是紫红色哥特彩窗
visual_symbols.en: purple-red gothic stained glass behind

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧烛台点着蜡烛，座前铺着红地毯
visual_symbols.en: lit candelabras on both sides and a red carpet before the throne

lighting.zh: 烛光暖金色，彩窗透出紫红光
lighting.en: warm gold candlelight with purple-red stained-glass glow

artworks.notes: scene 写「烛烟慢慢升起」，实际烟雾来自左侧的金色香炉，不是蜡烛；钥匙在座前台阶上而非地面。侍者袍上没有 RWS 的玫瑰/百合纹样，脸被兜帽遮住。

visual_description.zh: 花园石径分岔处，两只一模一样的奶蛙手牵着手；左边是开暗红玫瑰的树，右边是结石榴、缠着一条蛇的树，长翼天使在高处云中张开双臂。
visual_description.en: Where a garden path forks, two identical Naiwas hold hands; on the left a tree of dark red roses, on the right a pomegranate tree with a serpent coiled around it, and a winged angel opens its arms in the clouds above.

visual_symbols.zh: 两只一模一样的奶蛙并肩站立，手牵着手
visual_symbols.en: two identical Naiwas stand side by side holding hands

visual_symbols.zh: 带光环的长翼天使闭眼张开双臂，浮在云上
visual_symbols.en: a haloed, winged angel with closed eyes opens its arms above the clouds

visual_symbols.zh: 右边树干上缠着一条吐信的蛇
visual_symbols.en: a serpent coiled around the right tree, tongue out

visual_symbols.zh: 右边的树结满红色石榴
visual_symbols.en: the right tree is laden with red pomegranates

visual_symbols.zh: 左边的树开满暗红玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: the left tree is covered in dark red roses

visual_symbols.zh: 脚下石径分成左右两条，围成心形
visual_symbols.en: the stone path splits left and right, forming a heart shape

visual_symbols.zh: 远处山谷里有哥特城堡、拱桥和瀑布
visual_symbols.en: a gothic castle, arched bridge and waterfall in the distant valley

visual_symbols.zh: 右下角开着白百合
visual_symbols.en: white lilies at lower right

visual_symbols.zh: 地上散落着红色花瓣
visual_symbols.en: red petals scattered on the ground

lighting.zh: 天使身后的暖金光晕，四周紫色暮色
lighting.en: warm golden glow behind the angel against violet dusk

artworks.notes: scene 写「轻轻碰着小手」，实际两只奶蛙是手牵手；scene 写「红果」，实际为石榴；scene 完全没提右边树上的蛇，这是画面中很显眼的元素。左树开的是暗红玫瑰而非 scene 说的「黑玫瑰」（颜色偏暗红）。

visual_description.zh: 风暴夜空下，奶蛙戴金冠、披星纹蓝斗篷，坐在缀满星星的蓝色华盖下，手握星轮权杖；前方一黑一白两只戴埃及头巾的狮身兽被金链连在一根横杆上，右后方是亮灯的城堡。
visual_description.en: Under a stormy night sky, Naiwa in a gold crown and star-patterned blue cape sits beneath a star-spangled blue canopy holding a star-wheel sceptre; a black and a white sphinx in Egyptian headdresses are chained to a crossbar in front, a lit castle behind to the right.

visual_symbols.zh: 一黑一白两只戴蓝金条纹头巾的狮身兽卧在前方，黑的朝前、白的侧望右方
visual_symbols.en: a black and a white sphinx in striped headdresses lie in front, the black facing forward, the white looking right

visual_symbols.zh: 头顶深蓝华盖上缀满金色星星
visual_symbols.en: a deep blue canopy studded with gold stars overhead

visual_symbols.zh: 手握顶端为星形轮盘的金色权杖
visual_symbols.en: holds a gold sceptre topped with a star wheel

visual_symbols.zh: 戴着顶部有星形装饰的金冠
visual_symbols.en: a gold crown with a star ornament

visual_symbols.zh: 两只狮身兽之间用金链连在一根带星徽的横杆上
visual_symbols.en: gold chains link the sphinxes to a star-emblem crossbar

visual_symbols.zh: 右后方是亮着灯火的哥特城堡和城门
visual_symbols.en: a lit gothic castle and gate behind to the right

visual_symbols.zh: 左侧竖着一面绣八芒星的蓝色旗帜
visual_symbols.en: a blue banner with an eight-pointed star on the left

visual_symbols.zh: 座前镶着月桂环绕的八芒星徽
visual_symbols.en: a laurel-wreathed eight-pointed star emblem on the front

visual_symbols.zh: 翻涌的蓝黑风暴云
visual_symbols.en: roiling blue-black storm clouds

lighting.zh: 风暴夜的冷蓝光，城堡灯火与金饰反光
lighting.en: cold blue storm light with castle lamps and gleaming gold

artworks.notes: 画面中看不到车轮或车身，更像立在台阶上的华盖宝座；scene 写「站在小小的战车里，肚子顶着车沿」，实际奶蛙是坐着的，看不到车沿。scene 写「城门就在前方」，实际城堡在右后方背景。狮身兽被金链拴着，scene 未提。座前星徽对应 RWS 带翼圆盘的位置，但形态完全不同。

visual_description.zh: 满月下的玫瑰废园里，一头巨大的黑狮闭着眼、低头趴着，奶蛙伸手轻按在它的额头上；奶蛙头顶浮着发光的无限符号。
visual_description.en: In a moonlit ruined rose garden, a huge black lion lies with eyes closed and head lowered as Naiwa rests a hand on its forehead; a glowing infinity sign floats above Naiwa.

visual_symbols.zh: 鬃毛浓密的巨大黑狮闭眼低头，神态安详
visual_symbols.en: a huge black lion with a thick mane, eyes closed, head lowered and calm

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙伸出一只手，整个手掌轻按在狮子额头
visual_symbols.en: Naiwa reaches out and rests its whole palm on the lion's forehead

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙头顶浮着发光的金色无限符号
visual_symbols.en: a glowing golden infinity sign above Naiwa's head

visual_symbols.zh: 暗红玫瑰与常春藤爬满四周
visual_symbols.en: dark red roses and ivy all around

visual_symbols.zh: 狮子颈上戴着镶红宝石的金饰项圈
visual_symbols.en: the lion wears a gold collar set with a ruby

visual_symbols.zh: 一轮满月
visual_symbols.en: a full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 哥特拱门、废墟和柏树
visual_symbols.en: gothic arches, ruins and cypress trees

visual_symbols.zh: 脚下是落着花瓣的石阶
visual_symbols.en: petal-strewn stone steps underfoot

lighting.zh: 满月夜光加暖金色轮廓光
lighting.en: full-moon night light with warm gold rim light

artworks.notes: scene 写「用三根手指轻轻搭在它的鬃毛上」，实际是整只手掌按在狮子额头上，不是三根手指、也不在鬃毛上。狮子闭眼，不是在合拢下颌。

visual_description.zh: 雪夜的岩峰顶上，奶蛙披着积雪的深色破斗篷，一手提着发光六芒星的提灯，一手拄扭曲木杖；满月高挂，远山上是哥特废墟。
visual_description.en: On a snowy rock summit at night, Naiwa wears a snow-dusted ragged dark cloak, holding a lantern with a glowing six-pointed star in one hand and a twisted wooden staff in the other; a full moon hangs above gothic ruins on distant peaks.

visual_symbols.zh: 提着一盏铁艺提灯，灯里发光的六芒星
visual_symbols.en: holds an iron lantern with a glowing six-pointed star inside

visual_symbols.zh: 另一手拄着顶端弯曲的扭曲木杖
visual_symbols.en: leans on a twisted wooden staff with a curled top

visual_symbols.zh: 脚下是覆雪的岩石山顶
visual_symbols.en: a snow-covered rocky summit underfoot

visual_symbols.zh: 披着积雪的深色破边短斗篷，扣着六芒星扣
visual_symbols.en: a short ragged dark cloak dusted with snow, fastened with a hexagram clasp

visual_symbols.zh: 雪花从夜空落下
visual_symbols.en: snowflakes fall from the night sky

visual_symbols.zh: 一轮满月
visual_symbols.en: a full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 左右远山上各有哥特废墟
visual_symbols.en: gothic ruins on distant peaks to both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 山坡上几棵光秃枯树
visual_symbols.en: a few bare dead trees on the slopes

lighting.zh: 雪夜冷月光，提灯暖光照亮脚下
lighting.en: cold snowy moonlight, the lantern's warm glow lighting the ground

artworks.notes: 与 scene 基本一致。斗篷无兜帽、颜色为深灰黑色而非 RWS 的灰袍。左上云层带暗红色。

visual_description.zh: 紫色星云中悬着一个满是齿轮和炼金符号的古金轮盘，顶上坐着带翼狮身兽，左侧一条蛇向下滑，右侧一个胡狼头人形向上攀；四角是天使、鹰、带翼狮和带翼牛，奶蛙站在下方废墟间的石台上。
visual_description.en: A gilded wheel full of gears and alchemical signs hangs in violet nebulae; a winged sphinx sits atop, a serpent slides down the left and a jackal-headed figure climbs the right; angel, eagle, winged lion and winged bull fill the corners while Naiwa stands on a stone platform among ruins below.

visual_symbols.zh: 巨大的古金轮盘，内有齿轮、中心八芒星，外圈刻日、月、沙漏与炼金三角符号
visual_symbols.en: a huge gilded wheel with gears, an eight-pointed star at its centre, and sun, moon, hourglass and alchemical triangle signs on its rim

visual_symbols.zh: 轮顶坐着一只戴埃及头巾、带翅膀的狮身兽
visual_symbols.en: a winged sphinx in an Egyptian headdress sits on top

visual_symbols.zh: 一条蛇沿轮盘左侧向下滑
visual_symbols.en: a serpent slides down the left side of the wheel

visual_symbols.zh: 一个胡狼头人形攀在轮盘右侧
visual_symbols.en: a jackal-headed figure clings to the right side

visual_symbols.zh: 左上捧书的天使、右上鹰、左下咆哮的带翼狮、右下带翼牛
visual_symbols.en: a book-holding angel top-left, eagle top-right, roaring winged lion bottom-left, winged bull bottom-right

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙站在下方圆形石台上，正面朝外
visual_symbols.en: Naiwa stands on a round stone platform below, facing outward

visual_symbols.zh: 紫色星云、旋涡星系与一颗行星
visual_symbols.en: violet nebulae, a spiral galaxy and a planet

visual_symbols.zh: 云雾中的古柱和哥特拱门废墟
visual_symbols.en: ancient columns and gothic arch ruins in mist

lighting.zh: 宇宙星云紫光，金色轮盘自身发光
lighting.en: violet nebula light with a self-luminous golden wheel

artworks.notes: scene 没提右侧的胡狼头人形（对应 RWS 的阿努比斯），也没提下方废墟；scene 写「奶蛙站在轮底仰望」，实际奶蛙正面朝向观者，并没有抬头。狮身兽带翅膀。四活物中只有天使拿着书。轮盘上看不到 TARO 字母或希伯来字母。

visual_description.zh: 深红丝绒帷幕与两根石柱之间，奶蛙披深红斗篷端坐在哥特石座上，一手竖举长剑、一手提天平，身后有金色放射光环；两侧柱上立着蒙眼的女神雕像。
visual_description.en: Between crimson velvet curtains and two stone pillars, Naiwa in a crimson cape sits on a gothic stone throne holding an upright sword and a pair of scales, a golden radiant halo behind; blindfolded goddess statues stand on the pillars.

visual_symbols.zh: 一手竖直高举一把双刃长剑
visual_symbols.en: one hand holds a double-edged sword upright

visual_symbols.zh: 另一手提着一架金色天平，两盘平衡
visual_symbols.en: the other hand holds balanced golden scales

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧各一根深色石柱
visual_symbols.en: a dark stone pillar on each side

visual_symbols.zh: 身后挂着厚重的深红丝绒帷幕
visual_symbols.en: heavy crimson velvet curtains behind

visual_symbols.zh: 头后一圈金色放射光环
visual_symbols.en: a golden radiant halo behind the head

visual_symbols.zh: 柱上立着手持月桂枝、双眼被布条遮住的女神雕像
visual_symbols.en: goddess statues holding laurel sprigs with eyes covered by bands

visual_symbols.zh: 带尖拱的哥特石座，立在台阶上，基座刻月桂环绕的八芒星
visual_symbols.en: a gothic stone throne on steps, its base carved with a laurel-wreathed eight-pointed star

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧点着蜡烛的金色烛台
visual_symbols.en: lit golden candelabras on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 帷幕开口处可见满月和废墟
visual_symbols.en: a full moon and ruins visible through the curtain opening

lighting.zh: 烛光与月光交织，深红暖调
lighting.en: candle and moonlight in warm crimson tones

artworks.notes: scene 未提光环、雕像和满月。雕像的眼部覆有布条，疑似蒙眼的正义女神造型（RWS 正义牌本身并不蒙眼），未写入 rws_ref。

visual_description.zh: 雾气弥漫的魔法森林里，一条发光的丝带把奶蛙的一只脚系在古树横枝上，奶蛙倒挂着、另一条腿弯在身后，双手自然下垂，头部周围亮起金色光环；树下是溪流、蜡烛和白百合。
visual_description.en: In a misty enchanted forest, a glowing ribbon ties one of Naiwa's feet to a great tree's horizontal bough; Naiwa hangs upside down, other leg bent behind, arms loose, a golden halo around its head, with a stream, candles and white lilies below.

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙头朝下倒挂，表情平静
visual_symbols.en: Naiwa hangs upside down, expression calm

visual_symbols.zh: 一条发光的半透明丝带缠住一只脚，系在树枝上
visual_symbols.en: a glowing translucent ribbon wraps one foot and ties to the branch

visual_symbols.zh: 另一条腿弯曲架在身后
visual_symbols.en: the other leg is bent behind

visual_symbols.zh: 头部周围亮着金色放射光环
visual_symbols.en: a golden radiant halo around the head

visual_symbols.zh: 长满苔藓和常春藤的巨大古树，横枝跨过画面上方
visual_symbols.en: a huge mossy, ivy-covered tree whose bough spans the top

visual_symbols.zh: 双手自然下垂张开，没有被绑
visual_symbols.en: arms hang loosely open, not bound

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧苔石上点着白蜡烛
visual_symbols.en: white candles lit on mossy rocks on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 雾气中的林间溪流
visual_symbols.en: a forest stream in mist

visual_symbols.zh: 白百合
visual_symbols.en: white lilies

visual_symbols.zh: 树冠间可见满月，林中有哥特废墟
visual_symbols.en: a full moon through the canopy and gothic ruins in the woods

lighting.zh: 森林雾气中的冷月光，光环与丝带发出暖金光
lighting.en: cold misty moonlight with warm gold from the halo and ribbon

artworks.notes: scene 写「T 形古树」，实际是一棵巨大古树的横枝，T 形结构不明显，rws_ref 暂记 tau_tree 待人工确认。双手垂下而非背在身后。

visual_description.zh: 满月下的玫瑰废园里，奶蛙披着金纹黑色兜帽斗篷，骑白马、举着绣白玫瑰的黑色破旗；地上落着一顶金冠和红色花瓣，右侧两座哥特尖塔之间，太阳贴着地平线。
visual_description.en: In a moonlit ruined rose garden, Naiwa in a gold-trimmed black hooded cloak rides a white horse holding a tattered black banner with a white rose; a gold crown and red petals lie on the ground, and the sun sits on the horizon between gothic spires to the right.

visual_symbols.zh: 举着一面绣白玫瑰的黑色破边旗帜
visual_symbols.en: a tattered black banner bearing a white rose

visual_symbols.zh: 骑着一匹鬃毛卷曲、佩金饰马具的白马
visual_symbols.en: rides a curly-maned white horse with ornate tack

visual_symbols.zh: 披着绣金玫瑰纹的黑色兜帽斗篷
visual_symbols.en: a black hooded cloak embroidered with gold roses

visual_symbols.zh: 地上倒着一顶金冠
visual_symbols.en: a gold crown lying on the ground

visual_symbols.zh: 两座哥特尖塔之间，太阳贴着地平线发出橙光
visual_symbols.en: the sun on the horizon between two gothic spires, glowing orange

visual_symbols.zh: 四周爬满红玫瑰，地上散落红花瓣
visual_symbols.en: red roses climb all around and red petals strew the ground

visual_symbols.zh: 右侧背景有一丛白玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: a cluster of white roses on the right

visual_symbols.zh: 一轮满月
visual_symbols.en: a full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 爬满玫瑰的哥特拱门与断柱废墟
visual_symbols.en: rose-covered gothic arches and broken columns

lighting.zh: 月夜冷光与地平线橙色晨/暮光
lighting.en: cold moonlight with orange dawn or dusk on the horizon

artworks.notes: scene 写「王冠…散落一地」（复数），实际只看到一顶金冠；园中玫瑰多为鲜红色，另有白玫瑰。白马体型正常，不显得「小」。地平线的太阳无法判断是升起还是落下，scene 写「天正在亮」。

visual_description.zh: 月夜水池边，奶蛙背着一对白色羽翼、披白色绣金长袍，一只脚踏进水里、一只脚踩在岸石上，把银色的水从一只杯倒进另一只杯；远处蜿蜒小路通向群山间的太阳。
visual_description.en: By a moonlit pool, Naiwa with white feathered wings and a white gold-embroidered robe has one foot in the water and one on a rock, pouring silvery water from one cup into another; a winding road leads to a sun among distant mountains.

visual_symbols.zh: 从一只铜杯把发光的银色水流倒进另一只高脚杯
visual_symbols.en: pours glowing silver water from one bronze cup into a goblet

visual_symbols.zh: 一只脚踩在水里，一只脚踏在岸边石上
visual_symbols.en: one foot in the water, the other on a bank rock

visual_symbols.zh: 背后一对白色羽翼
visual_symbols.en: a pair of white feathered wings

visual_symbols.zh: 小路蜿蜒穿过山林，通向群山间的太阳
visual_symbols.en: a road winds through the hills toward a sun among mountains

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧开着白百合
visual_symbols.en: white lilies on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 白色绣金长袍，胸前三枚金色星纹圆扣
visual_symbols.en: a white robe with gold embroidery and three gold star medallions

visual_symbols.zh: 泛着涟漪和光点的水池
visual_symbols.en: a pool with ripples and glints of light

visual_symbols.zh: 一轮满月
visual_symbols.en: a full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 爬满开白花藤蔓的残破拱门
visual_symbols.en: ruined arches covered with white-flowering vines

lighting.zh: 月夜冷光，远处太阳的暖光，倒出的水泛银光
lighting.en: cool moonlight, warm light from the distant sun, silvery glowing water

artworks.notes: scene 写「小小的灰白翅膀」，实际翅膀较大、为白色；两只杯子形制不同（一只铜杯、一只高脚杯）。前景是白百合，RWS 原版是鸢尾，rws_ref 记 irises 仅表示位置对应。远处太阳是升是落无法判断。

visual_description.zh: 血月下的哥特礼拜堂里，奶蛙戴着发箍式的小角、背着红色蝠翼、披深红斗篷，坐在刻五芒星和山羊头骨的黑石台上，手里倒持火炬；台下两个黑色小人影戴着项圈和锁链跪着，地上是打开的镣铐。
visual_description.en: In a gothic chapel under a blood moon, Naiwa wears headband horns, red bat wings and a crimson cape, sitting on a black stone pedestal carved with a pentagram and goat skull, holding a torch upside down; below, two small dark figures kneel in collars and chains beside open shackles.

visual_symbols.zh: 台下两个低头跪着的黑色小人影，颈上戴金项圈连着锁链
visual_symbols.en: two small dark figures kneel with bowed heads, gold collars linked to chains

visual_symbols.zh: 锁链末端的镣铐在地上张开着
visual_symbols.en: the shackles at the chains' ends lie open on the floor

visual_symbols.zh: 一手倒持火炬，火焰朝下
visual_symbols.en: holds a torch upside down, flame pointing downward

visual_symbols.zh: 头上戴着一个带弯角的发箍
visual_symbols.en: a headband with curved horns

visual_symbols.zh: 背后一对暗红色蝠翼
visual_symbols.en: a pair of dark red bat wings

visual_symbols.zh: 黑石台正面刻着五芒星和山羊头骨
visual_symbols.en: a black stone pedestal carved with a pentagram and a goat skull

visual_symbols.zh: 拱窗外一轮血红色月亮
visual_symbols.en: a blood-red moon through the arch

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧点着淌蜡的红蜡烛
visual_symbols.en: dripping red candles on both sides

visual_symbols.zh: 暗红玫瑰和散落的花瓣
visual_symbols.en: dark red roses and scattered petals

visual_symbols.zh: 斗篷扣是五芒星，胸前挂着金链
visual_symbols.en: a pentagram cape clasp with a gold chain across the chest

lighting.zh: 血月红光与烛光，整体暗红
lighting.en: blood-moon red and candlelight, deep red overall

artworks.notes: 与 scene 基本一致；「锁链是松的」在画面中体现为镣铐张开放在地上。石台与斗篷扣上的五芒星疑似正立（尖朝上），不是 RWS 额头的倒五芒星。小人影没有角和尾巴。

visual_description.zh: 暴风雨夜，闪电劈中山顶的哥特高塔，塔顶起火，一顶金冠被掀上半空，石块四散；两缕发光的幽灵状光影坠落。奶蛙站在左前方爬满红藤的石阶上看着这一切。
visual_description.en: On a stormy night, lightning strikes a gothic tower on a hilltop; fire bursts from the top, a gold crown is flung into the air and stones scatter, while two glowing ghostly wisps fall. Naiwa stands on red-vined stone steps at front left, watching.

visual_symbols.zh: 一道橙色闪电劈中塔顶
visual_symbols.en: an orange lightning bolt strikes the tower top

visual_symbols.zh: 山顶的哥特高塔，塔顶和窗户里燃着火
visual_symbols.en: a gothic tower on the summit with fire at the top and in its windows

visual_symbols.zh: 一顶金冠被掀飞到半空
visual_symbols.en: a gold crown flung into the air

visual_symbols.zh: 石块和火星四处飞散
visual_symbols.en: stone blocks and sparks fly everywhere

visual_symbols.zh: 两缕发光的幽灵状光影向下坠落
visual_symbols.en: two glowing ghost-like wisps falling downward

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙站在前景石阶上，表情平静
visual_symbols.en: Naiwa stands on the foreground stone steps, expression calm

visual_symbols.zh: 爬满红色藤叶的残破拱门
visual_symbols.en: a ruined arch covered with red vine leaves

visual_symbols.zh: 黑灰色风暴云，边缘透出橙光
visual_symbols.en: black-grey storm clouds lit orange at the edges

visual_symbols.zh: 雾中的古拱桥和岩山
visual_symbols.en: old aqueducts and crags in the mist

lighting.zh: 暴风雨夜，闪电与火光照亮
lighting.en: stormy night lit by lightning and fire

artworks.notes: scene 写「靛色的风暴」，实际云层是黑灰色带橙光；scene 写奶蛙「站在远处」，实际奶蛙在左前景、离观者很近；scene 没提两缕下坠的发光幽灵光影——它们对应 RWS 坠落的人，但并不是清晰的人形，rws_ref 暂记 falling_figures 待确认。空中只有火星碎屑，没有 RWS 的 Yod 火滴。

visual_description.zh: 星空下的池塘边，奶蛙站在岩石上，两手各提一只银壶：左边的壶把闪光的星水倒进池里，右边的壶浇在黑玫瑰上；头顶一颗八芒大星和一圈小星，左边开花的树上停着一只黑鸟。
visual_description.en: Under the stars by a pond, Naiwa stands on a rock with a silver pitcher in each hand: the left pours sparkling star-water into the pond, the right waters black roses; a great eight-pointed star and a ring of small stars shine above, and a black bird perches in a blossoming tree.

visual_symbols.zh: 头顶一颗明亮的八芒大星
visual_symbols.en: a bright large eight-pointed star overhead

visual_symbols.zh: 大星周围环绕着一圈小星
visual_symbols.en: a ring of small stars around the great star

visual_symbols.zh: 两手各提一只刻星纹的银壶
visual_symbols.en: a star-engraved silver pitcher in each hand

visual_symbols.zh: 左壶的星光水流倒进池里，泛起光圈
visual_symbols.en: the left pitcher pours starlit water into the pond, sending out rings of light

visual_symbols.zh: 右壶的水浇在黑玫瑰丛上
visual_symbols.en: the right pitcher waters a bush of black roses

visual_symbols.zh: 左侧开白花的树枝上停着一只黑鸟
visual_symbols.en: a black bird perches on a white-blossomed branch at left

visual_symbols.zh: 黑玫瑰丛
visual_symbols.en: black rose bushes

visual_symbols.zh: 如镜的池塘倒映星光
visual_symbols.en: a mirror-like pond reflecting starlight

visual_symbols.zh: 瀑布、哥特拱门废墟和柏树
visual_symbols.en: a waterfall, gothic arch ruins and cypress trees

visual_symbols.zh: 紫色银河星空
visual_symbols.en: a violet Milky Way sky

lighting.zh: 星光夜，银色星辉与紫色天幕
lighting.en: starlit night with silver glow and a violet sky

artworks.notes: scene 写「周围七颗小星」，画面中小星目测约 8 颗，难以确认为 7 颗，请人工数；奶蛙是站着的，双脚都在岸石上，没有 RWS 的跪姿和一脚踏水。树上的鸟是黑色鸦类，不是 RWS 的朱鹭，rws_ref 仅表示位置对应。

visual_description.zh: 紫色雾气中，巨大的苍白满月挂在两座崖顶古塔之间，奶蛙站在蜿蜒小路上抱着戴红领结的黑兔玩偶；左边黑狗、右边白狼都仰头对月嚎叫，池里爬出一只小龙虾。
visual_description.en: In violet mist, an enormous pale full moon hangs between two clifftop towers; Naiwa stands on a winding path hugging a black rabbit plush with a red bow, a black dog on the left and a white wolf on the right howl at the moon, and a crayfish crawls from the pool.

visual_symbols.zh: 巨大的苍白满月
visual_symbols.en: an enormous pale full moon

visual_symbols.zh: 左边黑狗、右边白狼，都仰头对月嚎叫
visual_symbols.en: a black dog on the left and a white wolf on the right, both howling at the moon

visual_symbols.zh: 一只红色小龙虾从池里爬出
visual_symbols.en: a red crayfish crawls out of the pool

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧崖顶各有一座亮着窗灯的哥特古塔
visual_symbols.en: a gothic tower with lit windows on each clifftop

visual_symbols.zh: 一条小路从脚下蜿蜒伸向远山
visual_symbols.en: a path winds from underfoot into the distant hills

visual_symbols.zh: 倒映月亮的池塘，漂着睡莲
visual_symbols.en: a pool reflecting the moon, with water lilies

visual_symbols.zh: 怀里抱着一只戴红领结的黑兔玩偶
visual_symbols.en: hugs a black rabbit plush with a red bow

visual_symbols.zh: 紫色鸢尾花
visual_symbols.en: purple irises

visual_symbols.zh: 紫色云雾
visual_symbols.en: violet clouds and mist

lighting.zh: 紫雾中的苍白月光
lighting.en: pale moonlight in violet mist

artworks.notes: 与 scene 基本一致；scene 未提狗和狼都在对月嚎叫。黑狗毛色偏深褐黑。月亮没有人脸，也没有 RWS 的 Yod 光滴。

visual_description.zh: 金色阳光下，奶蛙披红斗篷、骑着毛茸茸的小白马，举着绣太阳纹的红旗走过花园石径；身后矮石墙上方长着高大的向日葵，天上一张温和的金色太阳脸，远处是哥特尖塔。
visual_description.en: In golden sunlight, Naiwa in a red cape rides a fluffy white pony along a garden path holding a red banner with a sun emblem; tall sunflowers rise above a low stone wall, a gentle golden sun face shines above, and gothic spires stand in the distance.

visual_symbols.zh: 放射光芒的金色太阳，带一张温和的人脸
visual_symbols.en: a radiant golden sun with a gentle human face

visual_symbols.zh: 骑着一匹毛茸茸的小白马
visual_symbols.en: rides a fluffy white pony

visual_symbols.zh: 举着一面绣金色太阳纹的红旗
visual_symbols.en: holds a red banner with a gold sun emblem

visual_symbols.zh: 墙后高大的向日葵，金黄花瓣、深色花心
visual_symbols.en: tall sunflowers with golden petals and dark centres behind the wall

visual_symbols.zh: 爬满藤蔓、带哥特拱饰的矮石墙
visual_symbols.en: a low vine-covered stone wall with gothic arches

visual_symbols.zh: 披着深红绣金斗篷
visual_symbols.en: a crimson gold-embroidered cape

visual_symbols.zh: 路边是红色花朵和白百合
visual_symbols.en: red flowers and white lilies line the path

visual_symbols.zh: 远处的哥特尖塔与柏树
visual_symbols.en: distant gothic spires and cypress trees

lighting.zh: 满画面暖金色阳光
lighting.en: warm golden sunlight throughout

artworks.notes: scene 写「黑向日葵」，实际向日葵是金黄花瓣、深色花心，并不是黑色；scene 未提红旗上的太阳纹。

visual_description.zh: 奶蛙背着黑白相间的羽翼、头后有金色放射光环，站在发光的云台上吹响金色号角，号角下挂着红十字白旗；云下的石棺纷纷打开，半透明的光灵顺着光束升起，周围开满白百合。
visual_description.en: With black-and-white feathered wings and a golden radiant halo, Naiwa stands on a glowing cloud blowing a golden trumpet hung with a white banner bearing a red cross; below, stone sarcophagi open and translucent spirits of light rise along the beams among white lilies.

visual_symbols.zh: 吹响一支金色号角
visual_symbols.en: blows a golden trumpet

visual_symbols.zh: 号角下挂着一面红十字白旗
visual_symbols.en: a white banner with a red cross hangs from the trumpet

visual_symbols.zh: 刻十字的哥特石棺盖子掀开，里面透出光
visual_symbols.en: gothic stone sarcophagi carved with crosses stand open, light spilling out

visual_symbols.zh: 半透明的人形光灵顺着光束升起
visual_symbols.en: translucent human-shaped spirits of light rise along the beams

visual_symbols.zh: 两侧翅膀都是白色上层、黑色下层的羽毛
visual_symbols.en: both wings have white upper and black lower feathers

visual_symbols.zh: 脚下发光的云台，向下洒出光束
visual_symbols.en: a glowing cloud underfoot casting beams downward

visual_symbols.zh: 头后一圈金色放射光环
visual_symbols.en: a golden radiant halo behind the head

visual_symbols.zh: 四周开满白百合
visual_symbols.en: white lilies all around

visual_symbols.zh: 雪山、瀑布、哥特拱廊废墟和山顶城堡
visual_symbols.en: snowy mountains, waterfalls, gothic arcade ruins and a hilltop castle

lighting.zh: 云中逆光，金色圣光束向下照射
lighting.en: backlit clouds with golden beams shining down

artworks.notes: scene 写「一黑一白的羽翼」，实际两只翅膀都是白色与黑色羽毛混合（上白下黑），并非一边黑一边白。复活者是半透明光灵，不是 RWS 的一家三口；石棺在云雾地面上，不是漂在海上。

visual_description.zh: 紫色星云旋涡前，月桂叶、黑玫瑰和金丝带编成的椭圆花环中央，奶蛙失重般漂浮着，两手各握一支星顶礼杖；四角圆形徽章里分别是天使、鹰、狮和牛。
visual_description.en: Before a swirling violet nebula, at the centre of an oval wreath of laurel, black roses and gold ribbon, Naiwa floats weightlessly with a star-topped wand in each hand; round medallions in the four corners hold an angel, eagle, lion and bull.

visual_symbols.zh: 月桂叶与黑玫瑰编成的椭圆花环，缠着金丝带，底部打蝴蝶结
visual_symbols.en: an oval wreath of laurel and black roses wrapped in gold ribbon, tied with a bow at the bottom

visual_symbols.zh: 奶蛙悬浮在花环中央，双脚并拢
visual_symbols.en: Naiwa floats in the centre of the wreath, feet together

visual_symbols.zh: 两手各握一支顶端带星光的金色礼杖
visual_symbols.en: a gold star-topped wand in each hand

visual_symbols.zh: 四角圆形徽章：左上天使、右上鹰、左下狮、右下牛
visual_symbols.en: round corner medallions: angel top-left, eagle top-right, lion bottom-left, bull bottom-right

visual_symbols.zh: 花环上点缀着多朵黑玫瑰
visual_symbols.en: several black roses set into the wreath

visual_symbols.zh: 缠绕花环的金色丝带
visual_symbols.en: gold ribbon winding around the wreath

visual_symbols.zh: 身后旋转的紫色星云旋涡
visual_symbols.en: a swirling violet nebula behind

visual_symbols.zh: 散落的金色四芒星
visual_symbols.en: scattered golden four-pointed stars

lighting.zh: 紫色星空，金色星光与暖金反光
lighting.en: violet starry sky with golden starlight and warm gold highlights

artworks.notes: 与 scene 基本一致。奶蛙双脚并拢，没有 RWS 的交叉腿姿势；丝带为金色，没有红色无限结。
